relations.title: Why bounded awareness may prevent mission drift without exhaustive domain knowledge
The Anthropology of Tiger Team Activation
Activación de misión
relations.reading: Mission activation offers a comparison for how the AICM programme connected a new perspective with concrete collective responsibility.

relations.title: Secuencia JUBAP
relations.reading: The AICM programme explicitly describes an adapted JUBAP route; the human-transformation article explains the perspective mechanism without establishing that every technique was used there.

relations.title: Resultado upstream independiente
relations.reading: The UP move can expose alternatives outside a local frame, while an independently stated upstream outcome is needed to judge whether the new perspective is coherent.

relations.title: Diagnóstico de insuficiencia frente a reconstrucción
relations.reading: JUBAP’s perspective shift could motivate a test of whether recognizing a frame’s limits protects the mission more effectively than adding unrelated domain detail.

relations.title: Diagnóstico de insuficiencia frente a reconstrucción
relations.reading: The framework’s perspective shift may motivate a later test of epistemic-limit awareness, without making its historical cases evidence that FH-C is already proven.
